collection.title: SEAT Toledo 2012 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A SEAT Toledo 2012 to 2018 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 15" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Toledo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
